robustness.sentence: Stable: the difference in Agreeableness between gender = 1 and gender = 2 keeps the same direction and significance in every exclusion variant. This shows sensitivity to exclusion choices. It does not prove which respondents should be excluded.
robustness.caveat: This shows sensitivity to exclusion choices. It does not prove which respondents should be excluded.
